description: Land Acquisition - Welamitiyawa, Dambulla D/S Division, Matale District
categorisation: This gazette content is primarily about land acquisition under the Land Acquisition Act, specifically declaring that 12 allotments of land are needed for public purpose. It contains detailed descriptions of land parcels, boundaries, and extents, which falls squarely under the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) for land and property-related matters. While it mentions a government minister, the core content is about land acquisition rather than government personnel or structural changes.
